name: RTL Group S.A.
summary: RTL Group S.A. operates as an entertainment company. The company operates television (TV) channels and radio stations; and provides streaming services, including RTL+, Videoland, and M6+ in France, Germany, Spain, Luxembourg, Hungary, and the Netherlands. It is also involved in radio and digital publishing business. In addition, the company operates Fremantle, a producer and distributor of scripted and unscripted content; Bedrock, a streaming tech business; Smartclip, an ad-tech business; and social media business under the We Are Era name. The company was founded in 1924 and is based in Luxembourg, Luxembourg. RTL Group S.A. operates as a subsidiary of Bertelsmann Capital Holding GmbH.
